items.title: Why China’s DUV Push Hit ASML (ASML) and Micron (MU) for Different Reasons

State-backed Shanghai Aishengna Electronic Technology Group plans to deliver machines to Semiconductor Manufacturing International, Hua Hong Semiconductor and memory producer ChangXin Memory Technologies.
